page.overview:
What is Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Onyudo?

The Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Onyudo is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into an onyudo, a large monk yokai, at will. It was eaten by Onimaru.

This fruit's ability is to transform into an onyudo: a mythical, human-like yokai that takes the form of a giant monk; Onimaru, in particular, stands at over four meters tall. This fruit being of the Hito Hito no Mi series, its transformation grants a nonhuman user human intelligence and the ability to speak the human language.

It appears that this transformation grants the user several bladed weapons, most prominently a naginata as well as a sword sheathed on their hip, that they can use in combat. When Onimaru transforms back into his normal form, the weapons as well as his monk clothing seem to disappear.

So far, no weakness of this Devil Fruit power is known beside the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
